items.text: Hey everyone, in case this update brought you here, the game has just been updated to include the fix for the Unity security vulnerability.
This update means the game is fully up to date and secure. You can read more about the Unity issue here:
[dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/groups/steamworks/announcements/detail/524229329545071275"]
Thanks for keeping your game updated, and as always, we appreciate your support!

If you thought the other updates were small, this one's so small it doesn't even have the last paragraph. This is a fix for cases where the backup save isn't corrupted, but also isn't a valid save file which can happen if it's been edited using an external program. Fingers crossed this should finally for real for real be the end of the save data issues, but if you're STILL having issues where you can't start the game please let us know on our discord.

Yet another small patch. Previously there was a fix to deal with players save data being corrupted and forcing them to restart the game, so we changed things so the game first backs up your old save before writing new data incase something goes wrong. However when the save was backed up the game didn't check to see if it was corrupted, leading to cases where both your main AND backup saves were corrupted. Now the game properly checks if your save is valid before backing it up so it won't back up corrupted data.

The other big change is that we've removed the ability to re-map controls that were bound to the mouse. Alas, my dreams of seeing someone speedrun the game with bongos have been shattered, but it was a sacrifice that had to be made. Often times players would accidentally rebind mouse inputs while remapping other controls and think that the game was broken when their mouse wasn't working they way they expected, so we've removed mouse re-mapping to help with this confusion. If you have previously re-mapped the mouse controls they'll continue to use your custom mapping until you reset them either in the input remapping menu or by holding ESC at the title screen for a few seconds to reset all your settings. Apologies to anyone who was using mouse re-mapping in earnest.

Another patch, another set of fixes. The big one this time is dealing with issues some players have been having with the alternate version of Everything Rots, the clips for which were using the wrong file format causing them to not work on some machines. Aside from that the other notable thing is there are some fixes for the polish and korean localizations removing new line characters (\n) that were left in the subtitle text.

If your still having issues with videos playing after this try updating your graphics card drivers. Some players have also mentioned that if your using an Nvidia graphics card disabling v-sync (vertical sync) in your Nvidia control panel separately from the in-game v-sync can also help.

But as is tradition, here's the last paragraph from the previous update: "Do you think anyone will notice if I just copy the last paragraph again? "I'm just gonna copy this last bit from the previous update post because it's still true, "As always please continue to let us know if you run into any issues! If something goes wrong you can always send us your logs over our discord, which will help us fix things faster. And thank you again for playing Amanda the Adventurer!"""

Yet another small update with more bug fixes, this time mostly addressing the issue where some players couldn't continue their game after coming back to it and were given a broken start button instead of the new game/continue buttons. This was due to how the game checks for corrupted save files. In some cases if saving is interrupted it's possible for the game to save an empty file, which isn't technically corrupted, so the game would treat it as a valid save file which would break everything. Now the game properly treats an empty file as it would a corrupted file, and will load the backup save.

Do you think anyone will notice if I just copy the last paragraph again? If something goes wrong you can always send us your logs over our discord, which will help us fix things faster. And thank you again for playing Amanda the Adventurer!""

Another small patch, this time mostly for adding the option to have y-axis look inverted for all you ex-pilots out there. There's also some minor bug fixes for the pie tin not accepting ingredients if you had solved one oven puzzle then pivoted to the other, and fixes for vSync settings not being saved properly which should also help with the settings issues people have been encountering.

I'm just gonna copy this last bit from the previous update post because it's still true, "As always please continue to let us know if you run into any issues! If something goes wrong you can always send us your logs over our discord, which will help us fix things faster. And thank you again for playing Amanda the Adventurer!"

This another quick patch for people that had issues with their options not working. There was an issue with this previously that was fixed, but if your option settings were corrupted you had to reset them manually by holding ESC on the title screen. Now the game will automatically detect corrupted option settings and revert them to their default values instead of letting everything break.

As always please continue to let us know if you run into any issues! If something goes wrong you can always send us your logs over our discord, which will help us fix things faster. And thank you again for playing Amanda the Adventurer!
中国的玩家们，你们好! 我们更正了一个错误，即按下空格键会在你的文字输入后加上一个空格，这影响了用中文写的答案。如果这没有意义，很抱歉，这是机器翻译的。谢谢您的参与!
中國玩家好！我們修復了一個錯誤，即按空格鍵會在文本輸入后添加一個空格，這會影響用中文編寫的答案。對不起，如果這沒有意義，這是町
No, this isn't a secret that you have to uncover by learning Chinese, this is just to let Chinese players know that the bug causing issues with Chinese text input should be fixed now.

But that's not all there is to this update! We've also got a bug fix for dealing with corrupted saves, so if you played the game and came back the next day to find that it wasn't working that's probably why. The game will now back up your saves so if your save gets corrupted it'll use the backup instead. Unfortunately since this was just added if your save was corrupted previously you'll have to start over again.

We've also had reports of the game getting stuck while trying to play videos. If this happens please update your graphics card drivers and try again. If you continue to run into this issue after you've updated your graphics card drivers please let us know.
There's also a small tweak to prevent cases where people accidentally get the Splish Splash achievement. Your gonna have to figure out this one properly now!
As always please let us know if you run into any issues, and thank you for playing Amanda the Adventurer.
No, this isn't adding more secrets (yet).

This is just a quick patch to fix the issues some of yall' have been running into with the options screen. If you've run into issues with the options before such as some options not making sense or not working you'll need to reset your settings. You can do this from the main menu and holding the ESC key for a few seconds, when you hear a chime play your settings should be reset and there (hopefully) shouldn't be any more issues with them.
There's a few other misc fixes in there too, the full patch notes are as follows:
Amanda v1.6.11
-Fixed snap zoom not unpausing the tv
-Fixed blabbot talking over himself in some cases
-Fixed very bottom of intro letter being cut off on ultrawide monitors
-Fixed options button text breaking other options if the display text index was out of range. Will display error text if it happens instead
-Fix for resolution setting index being set out of range
-Potential fix for issue where tapes would get stuck between scenes

We're still working on getting things ironed out so there'll probably be more patches down the line. Again, if you run into any issues please let us know. Sending us your logs can also help us fix things faster, they can be found at C:\Users\ [Your computer username] \AppData\LocalLow\MangledMaw\Amanda The Adventurer
And thank you again for playing Amanda The Adventurer!
